Method of Attack: The package compromises any computer that has it installed or running, potentially giving full control to an outside entity. All secrets and keys stored on the computer should be rotated immediately from a different computer. Removing the package does not guarantee removal of all malicious software resulting from its installation.
Impacted Systems: Any computer with the package installed or running
Attack Vector: Installation or running of the malicious npm package com.unity.modules.unityanalytics
